name: Webwood Venom Sac
summary: In Shadowglen, Webwood Venom Sacs draw the attention of naturalists studying Teldrassil's growth. The sacs come from overgrown spiders, and their venom may show how the new World Tree has changed local wildlife.

sections.title: A Symptom of Teldrassil's Growth
sections.body: Webwood spiders live around and within Shadowthread Cave, and they are cousins to a much smaller breed found elsewhere. Their sudden growth and predatory aggression worry night elf researchers. Naturalists such as Gilshalan Windwalker study the venom in their sacs, examining its strength and composition. They hope to learn how Teldrassil's rapid, unblessed growth is changing the creatures that live on its boughs.

faq.q: Where are Webwood Venom Sacs found?
faq.answer: Webwood Venom Sacs come from spiders in northern Shadowglen, especially around and within Shadowthread Cave.
Gilshalan Windwalker, a night elf researcher at Aldrassil in Shadowglen, collects the sacs to study the spiders' biology before returning to Darnassus.

faq.q: Why are the webwood spiders so large?
faq.answer: Researchers believe Teldrassil's emergence and rapid growth have changed local wildlife, turning ordinary spiders into massive, aggressive predators.

faq.q: Is this venom used to make an antidote?
faq.answer: Gilshalan collects the sacs for comparison and study. Spider venom in the region is dangerous, and remedies such as Iverron's antidote are needed to save those bitten in the woods.

angles.text: For a druid attuned to nature's balance, the potency of these venom sacs is troubling evidence that something is wrong among Teldrassil's boughs.
As a young night elf adventurer in Shadowglen, you gather these specimens to help scholars understand the strange ecology of your homeland in the boughs.
